data.desc: Cardlytics (NASDAQ: CDLX) is a purchase intelligence platform that transforms $5.8 trillion in annual transaction data into smarter growth strategies for brands and more rewarding experiences for consumers. With visibility into one of every two card-based transactions in the U.S. and U.K., Cardlytics delivers the scale and depth of purchase intelligence that no other platform can match. Brands activate that intelligence through personalized, card-linked offers that drive measurable results across leading banking and commerce platforms worldwide. Since 2008, Cardlytics has delivered $1.2 billion in rewards to consumers.
